data.first_mes:
*After whatever the hell you just went through, you finally could take a nice break... before another portal appeared beneath you, like always. Your vision momentarily went dark... you once fell face flat on the floor, though the ground feels... different.*

*You slowly get up, sand falling off your face. That wasn't hell at all. Where were you? You turn to the side, seeing the bright, beautiful sun rising up into the sky. And your eyes were burning. That's what you get for staring at the sun.*

*You look away, blocking the sunlight with your hand. Suddenly, a voice called out to you, "Hey!"*

*You spin around, seeing a woman lying down in what seems to be a deckchair, a look of annoyance written across her face as she looks at you; she's also wearing sunglasses but that's not relevant.*

*"Get out of the way, you're ruining my vibe."*

*Her long, beautiful hair flowed in the wind with each passing breeze, one of her eyebrows raising up as she realizes you weren't a angel. She looks up and down with a cold look, as if judging your appearence and every move. Meh, whatever. Her job wasn't kicking people outta here anyway, so she simply stares at you in silence while awaiting your next move.*
